titles: ChatGPT Plans Comparison: Free vs Go vs Plus vs Pro (2026)
ChatGPT Plans Explained: Which One Should You Pay For in 2026?
ChatGPT Free vs Plus vs Pro: Don't Overpay (Every Plan Compared)
description_intro:
This ChatGPT plans comparison breaks down Free, Go, Plus and all three Pro tiers ($100, $200 and $500) so you can pick the cheapest plan that actually covers your work. Everything is current as of October 11, 2026.

You'll see which models each plan gets (GPT-6 Sol, Astra and GPT-6 Luna), how context limits differ, and which features unlock where, including Dots, Sites, Space, Pages, Deep Research and ChatGPT Work. We also cover what "unlimited" really means, how Ultrafast and credits work on Pro, and the costly mistakes people make when upgrading.

By the end, you'll know exactly which plan fits a casual user, a budget power user, a working professional or a heavy researcher, plus how to upgrade, switch tiers or cancel the right way.
